meta.method: Each quantitative or dated factual statement in the four Phase-1 reports was extracted with its line number. Derived figures were re-computed from the report's own inputs. Cross-report agreement was checked. External URLs cited by news.md and sentiment.md were NOT fetched; claims resting only on those URLs are marked single_source and are not independently verified. The four report files were not modified.

status_legend.corroborated: Same fact appears in two or more reports, or matches the report's own raw-source field.
status_legend.single_source: Appears in one report only, from a stated source that was not independently checked here.
status_legend.derived_verified: A figure the report computed that re-computes correctly from its stated inputs (within rounding).
status_legend.derived_mismatch: A figure the report computed or labeled that does not re-compute from its stated inputs.
status_legend.conflict: Two or more reports (or sources cited within them) give different values for the same item.
status_legend.stale_or_undated: Date is missing, unclear, or the item appears to be older than the analysis window.
status_legend.estimate: Forecast, consensus-based expectation, or assumed date.
status_legend.interpretive: Analyst judgment or opinion rather than a checkable fact.
